newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's pleased with second quarter results.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's pleased with second quarter results.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said Tuesday it was pleased with its performance in the second quarter.
Kohl's earned $20.8 million, or $0.28 a share, during the period versus $14.8 million, or $0.20 a share, during the same quarter last year.

"We are extremely pleased with the second quarter and the first half of 1997. Our comparable store sales increase of 10.1 percent for the first half was on top of a 9.3 percent comparable store increase last year. Operating income for the first half increased 30.4 percent in spite of $8.4 million more in pre-opening costs than last year. Excluding pre-opening costs, operating income increased 42.6 percent over last year," William Kellogg, Chairman of Kohl's, said in a statement.

In October, Kohl's said it would open four additional stores in the Philadelphia area, an additional store in the Washington, D.C. market, its second store in Omaha, Neb., a store in Binghamton, N.Y., and enter the Pittsburgh market with three stores. At the end of the year, Kohl's said it planned to operate 182 stores.
